MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug gives the Echo devices I already use a new purpose: controlling a lamp instead of adding another speaker or screen.",
    "Echo Auto could extend familiar Alexa controls to my car if it works with my phone and car. The USB adapters also fit my history of keeping computer peripherals usable, provided I actually need that connection."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks repeat a job my Fire TV Stick 4K Max already handles, so their connection to my purchases does not give me a reason to choose them now.",
    "The older Echo Dot and Show 5 duplicate newer devices I recently bought. Buying a stand for my Show 5 suggests I am setting up that device, rather than looking for an older replacement.",
    "The earbuds and tablet offer uses I have not recently shown a need for; interest in electronics alone does not make them useful next purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Amazon device purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any other Amazon device, even when it repeats something I own.",
    "My history of buying electronics seems to have been stretched into an assumed need for portable entertainment and earbuds."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own and which generation it is matter: a recently purchased newer device leaves little reason to choose an older device for the same job.",
    "My stand, replacement batteries, readers, and adapters suggest that making existing equipment more useful can matter more to me than buying another main device.",
    "Compatibility matters before I choose an accessory: the USB adapter needs to solve an actual connection problem, and Echo Auto needs to work with my phone and car."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in Alexa and practical electronics, but often confused adding useful capabilities with duplicating devices I already own."
}
